summary: Frontend-only UI/integration testing of the Zelarion marketing landing page. Ran a comprehensive Playwright sweep across desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844): section rendering, all required data-testids, hero content, scroll behaviour, showcase scroll-expand (no trap), metrics count-up, features/how/integrations/security content, pricing tiers, founders name-only rule, FAQ accordion expand/collapse, final CTA, footer, R3F 3D crystal presence, banned-word content audit (case-insensitive across textContent), mobile hamburger menu, and horizontal-overflow check at 4 scroll positions. Every acceptance criterion passed. No page (runtime) errors, no broken images, no horizontal overflow, no banned marketing language.

issues: The TravellingCore R3F crystal at its docking waypoint (progress ~0.73, scale 1.35) briefly renders very large behind the testimonial and just above the founders grid. Text remains legible (canvas is z-2, content is z-10) so it is not a functional bug, but the wireframe edges visually compete with the pull-quote. Consider capping max scale to ~1.05 at this waypoint or lowering opacity so the crystal reads as a background prop rather than a foreground element in the testimonial band.

verified_acceptance_criteria.travelling_3d_core: PASS – R3F <canvas> present in fixed z-2 layer (1920x1080), faceted teal icosahedron with cyan edges + indigo inner core, animates on scroll via scrollStore.progress.
verified_acceptance_criteria.content_rule_audit: PASS – case-insensitive textContent search across the whole rendered DOM returned ZERO occurrences of: $1M, 1 million, ARR, revenue, on track, TBA, TBD, coming soon, up to, as low as, starting from, approximate, and more, contact us, custom pricing, contact sales.
verified_acceptance_criteria.responsive_mobile_390px: PASS – nav-mobile-toggle visible (desktop CTA cluster display:none), tapping toggle opens nav-mobile-menu with Platform/Solutions/Pricing/Company + Sign in + Book a demo. Sections stack vertically. scrollWidth == 390 at 0%, 25%, 50%, 75%, 100% — no horizontal overflow anywhere on the 16,629px-tall mobile page.

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: ScrollExpandShowcase logs two framer-motion warnings — 'container has a non-static position' — because useScroll({target: sectionRef}) is called on a section that is `relative h-[300vh]` but the sticky inner has no relative parent chain issue that framer-motion is happy with. Non-blocking (scroll math still works), but worth adding `position: relative` on the sticky inner or switching to a layoutEffect target ref to silence the warning.
Minor: TravellingCore keyframe p=0.73 uses scale 1.35 which visually dominates the testimonial band on desktop (see design_issues). Consider tapering to <=1.0 at this waypoint.
Info: `.env` values look correct; frontend uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL for the public URL and no hardcoded URLs found in components.
action_items: OPTIONAL polish only: reduce TravellingCore scale at the p=0.73 waypoint from 1.35 to ~1.0 so the wireframe crystal stops visually crowding the testimonial pull-quote and the founders row above.

OPTIONAL polish only: silence the two framer-motion 'non-static position' warnings by ensuring the useScroll target element itself carries `position: relative` (or move the ref to the inner sticky element).
